## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link related Scenario data publications or design documents.

## Scope and contracts

- Affected components: Model / Scenario / Asset / Visualizer
- Scientific data, coordinate, time or provenance changes:
- Compatibility and publication impact:
- Public Scenario budget report: total ≤200 MB; Geometry and Physics State each ≤150 MB. Run `python3 asset/tools/check_budgets.py --verify-remote` and include actual totals.

For a new Scenario, follow the [Scenario guide](https://github.com/CANOPY-WORLD/canopy-scenario-guide) and explain the curated-catalog policy change. Keep payloads in the independent data repository and view behavior in the shared Visualizer.

## Validation

Record actual commands and results, including any checks not run and why. Include appropriate contract, repository, unit and browser checks. Do not mark unexecuted checks as passed.

## Review evidence

Link reproducible examples, screenshots where useful, snapshot identities and relevant performance measurements. Note remaining limitations and any follow-up work.
